title: Asiad: Pinoy teenager impresses despite falling short of teqball podium
summary: A Filipino teenager just fell short of a historic podium finish in teqball for the Philippines, but earned praise for his valiant effort in the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya in Japan.
